message: 召喚師ｖｓ召喚師
After school. We decided to hold a Crusaders training session to keep ourselves sharp.
Apparently, Ria-senpai is using the spare time before we start to drop by the Wagashi Club's practice.
I can easily picture what a sports club's practice looks like, but I can't imagine at all what kind of things the Wagashi Club does.

name: Paqy
message: 「Why don't we just go take a look?」

name: Synn
message: 「Good point.」
And so, I'm heading over to Prier.

name: Synn
message: 「Ria-sen--」

name: Ria
message: 「It's been a while, so let's have a match, Akane-chan.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「It really has been ages. Hasn't it been since you handed in your leave of absence, saying you had to join the Student Council, Rii-a?」

name: Synn
message: 「A-A Wagashi Club match?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ooooh, contestant Misasagi is rubbing contestant Kujou the wrong way! Commentator Sally-chan, could this be a strategy?」

name: Sally
message: 「More importantly, I'm hungry.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Why the heck are these two mixed up in this?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Ready then? Here you go, kashiwa mochi.」
Just like Ria-senpai always does for us, a kashiwa mochi appears out of nowhere in Misasagi-senpai's palm.

name: Ria
message: 「Ta-da! Kashiwa mochi x2.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Not bad at all, pulling them out of both hands like that.」

name: Ria
message: 「I've still got it, ahem!」

name: Ria
message: 「Here you go, Takahashi-san. Eat up.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「You have some too, Sally-chan.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Nom nom, munch munch, it's delicious!」

name: Sally
message: 「Chew chew, chomp chomp, so yummy!」

name: Paqy
message: 「So you guys really are just here to eat!!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Now that the warm-up's out of the way, shall we get serious?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Hmph, three-color dango.」

name: Ria
message: 「Ta-da! Baked manju.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Genjimaki!」

name: Ria
message: 「Then I'll counter with rose petal yokan.\s07」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Ohoho, you haven't gone soft in the Student Council after all, Ri-a.」

name: Ria
message: 「If anything, I've been getting whipped into shape~」

name: Paqy
message: 「Uwah... Ria-chan in battle mode is adorable too.」

name: Synn
message: 「Senpai hasn't even transformed, you know?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Can't you feel it? A honed fighting spirit is a beautiful thing.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Hmph, muscat monaka.」

name: Ria
message: 「Ta-da! Strawberry daifuku.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「That leaves you with just one more shot, Ri-a.」

name: Ria
message: 「Heh, you think so?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「...The very heart that wishes to enter upon that path is, within oneself, one's own true master.」

name: Ria
message: 「While learning, watch and learn indeed; to speak of good or bad without learning is foolishness.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hoho, that black-stockinged one...」

name: Synn
message: 「Paqy?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Auu, my headache hurts!」

name: Sally
message: 「Eek, it's so hard my head's gonna split~」

name: Ria & Misasagi
message: 「Ta-da! It's kinton♪」\n「Hmph, it's Mr. Kinton, ya know.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Looks like your skills haven't dulled, kinton is a wagashi befitting the eleventh month.」

name: Ria
message: 「Right back at you, Akane-chan, heeheehee.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Well then, shall we have some tea? Come join us too, President.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, she noticed we were watching...」

name: Sally
message: 「Kaha, so good~」

name: Sacchin
message: 「See ya! I'm gonna thank you for the food and get out of here before Nana-chan finds out~」

name: Misasagi
message: 「'Twas nothing much at all.」

name: Ria
message: 「...Synn-kun, did you notice? That Akane-chan was holding back against me.」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I didn't notice at all.」

name: Ria
message: 「Up until now, we've managed to scrape by like that, but...」

name: Ria
message: 「Knowing how to hold back means being able to see right through your opponent's true strength.」

name: Ria
message: 「From here on out, we're gonna have to hone our skills even more--both of us, got it?」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yes.」
She doesn't say the words Demons, Demon Generals, or Re-Crea, yet it's obvious my upperclassman is talking about the future of the Crusaders.

name: Misasagi
message: 「I don't quite know what's goin' on, but you oughta relax and enjoy your tea a bit more.」

name: Ria
message: 「Aha, ahahaha...」
With Misasagi-senpai easing the tension, Ria-senpai and I thoroughly enjoyed our tea time.
